errors.message: 未知のキーです。'mutation_score' の誤りではありませんか
数値を指定してください（受信値: "75%"）

validation.rawYaml:
version: 1
metrics:
  branch_coverage:
    threshold: "75%"
  mutation_scor:
    threshold: 60

defaultYaml:
version: 1

execution:
  skippable_metrics: [mutation_score, performance]

metrics:
  branch_coverage:
    threshold: 75
    warn_below: 80
  mutation_score:
    threshold: 60
  performance:
    p95_ms: 500
    arrival_rate_rps: 50
    error_rate_pct: 0.1
  vulnerabilities:
    max_critical: 0
    max_high: 0
  cyclomatic_complexity:
    max_complexity: 15
    warn_from: 11
  api_contract:
    breaking_changes: 0
  test_results:
    min_success_rate: 100
    min_test_count: 1
    max_skipped_increase: 0
  accessibility:
    standard: wcag22aa
    max_critical: 0
